# Summary Placeholder Labs is a collaboration (DOrg) between Mahogany, Decentration and New-Futures, with a mission to experiment and develop new technologies, to innovate, enable immersive experiences and new systems for the music industry. **What is a DOrg?** It is a decentralised organisation or DAO registered with Kabocha (or Edgeware). # Partners **Mahogany** - One of the leading global platforms for music content and live activations, with operations in the UK, US and Australia - they have created original content with the likes of Billie Eilish, Florence + Machine, Rag n Bone Man, George Ezra and hundreds more to a global audience of over 1.5M fans. https://www.youtube.com/c/MahoganySessions https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qdMnBgzSdeo Key member from Mahogany: Mark **New Futures** - A creative collective focussed on immersive experiences and blockchain Technology. New-Futures focuses on attention catching content and the places to experience it. We are stepping into a new paradigm of content immersion. Placeholder labs will be the first of its kind, a Web 3 music (consumption) experience - Living memorabilia.
